styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Kalemegdan fortress, Ottoman lanes and Yugoslav past.

styles.label: Nightlife
styles.blurb: Splavovi river clubs and long kafana nights.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Ćevapi, burek and market-to-table Balkan plates.

stays.why: Old-town core: walk to Kalemegdan, Knez Mihailova and Skadarlija. Best for first-timers.
Quiet, leafy streets near the St. Sava temple; good cafés and easy tram links to the centre.
Modern blocks and river hotels; cheaper rooms, close to the splavovi nightlife strip.
Old Habsburg town on the Danube: calm, good fish restaurants, a short bus or train to the centre.

food: Try ćevapi (grilled minced-meat rolls), burek and kajmak; portions are big, so share.
Skadarlija, the old cobbled street, is the classic spot for a long kafana dinner with live music.
Zemun on the Danube is known for fish restaurants; check the day's catch and prices first.
Cheap eats: bakeries and grill stands sell burek or a sandwich for a few hundred RSD.
Coffee is a ritual: sit at a café for hours. Tap water is safe to drink.
more_time: Add a day trip to Novi Sad and Petrovaradin fortress; check current train and bus times on the day.
History fans can swap a city day for the Roman ruins at Viminacium or the Danube fortresses downstream.
On a hot summer day, swap sightseeing for Ada Ciganlija: the river island beach with swimming and cafés.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the fortress, old town and a long kafana night; add a third for Zemun or a Novi Sad day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 5°C, lows around -2°C, with about 12 rain days. Pack a warm coat.
Still chilly, highs near 10°C; snow possible early on. Fewer crowds.
Mild and changeable, highs near 13°C; about 10 rain days. Bring layers.
Spring warms up: highs near 18°C, pleasant for walking and café terraces.
Warm and wet: highs near 22°C with about 13 rain days, the rainiest month. Keep an umbrella.
Early summer: highs near 27°C, about 12 rain days. Good for outdoor sightseeing.
Hot and mostly dry: highs near 29°C, lows near 19°C. Plan shade and water by day.
Hottest, driest stretch: highs near 29°C with only about 7 rain days. River clubs are in full swing.
Warm and comfortable: highs near 24°C, about 8 rain days. A great month to visit.
Mild autumn: highs near 19°C, about 7 rain days. Good for walking and day trips.
Cooler and greyer: highs near 12°C, about 10 rain days. Pack a jacket.
Cold: highs near 7°C, lows near 1°C, about 10 rain days. Expect festive city lights.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate: cold winters, warm to hot summers, and rain spread fairly evenly through the year.

items.title: Best time: April to June and September to October
items.text: Mild highs of about 18–27°C and fewer extreme days. Ideal for walking the fortress and old town.

items.title: Summer can be hot (July–August)
items.text: Highs near 29°C and warm nights around 19°C. Sightsee in the morning; evenings are for the river clubs.

items.title: Winter is cold (December–February)
items.text: Highs of 5–10°C and lows near or below freezing. Snow is possible. Bring a proper coat and warm shoes.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 7–13 rain days every month, peaking in May. A compact umbrella is worth packing any month.

items.title: Big swings between seasons
items.text: From about 5°C highs in January to 29°C in July–August. Check the forecast before you pack.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers and a light rain jacket in spring and autumn; a warm coat, hat and gloves in winter; light clothes and sunscreen in summer.

transit.best: Free city buses and trams for most trips; use a ride app or a marked taxi at night.

modes.text: No metro yet. Don't plan around it.
City buses, trams and trolleybuses are free. Express E-lines and trains are not. Trams converge around Slavija and Vukov Spomenik.
BG:Voz suburban trains link the main stations; useful for Zemun and beyond. Not free.
Car:Go, Pink Taxi and Yandex Go need SMS verification. Only use taxis with a roof sign and plates ending in TX; insist on the meter.
Driving is stressful at rush hour. Keep low beams on and watch for police speed traps.
The old town, Kalemegdan and Skadarlija are compact and walkable. Watch for traffic on bigger roads.
